notes.title: Double battles
notes.text: Two story trainers who name each other as partners start one double battle: your first two healthy Pokémon against one Pokémon from each trainer. Each of your Pokémon picks a move and a target; all four act by priority and Speed.

notes.title: Frameless Pokémon chat and Pokémon League themes
notes.text: Pokémon headers, narration and lines no longer use frames and blend into the SillyTavern background. RoleForge chat themes gain Pokémon League · Day and · Night.

notes.title: Kinetic dark mode and new screens
notes.text: Kinetic follows the device or a chosen Light/Dark mode. Bag pockets, a Storage box grid with pick-up bar, team presets, Pokédex completion, a post-battle summary, catch and evolution scenes, swipe and pull-to-close gestures and optional vibration on Android.
